name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 39 – Am 71
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 39a. Stresses that EU migration and asylum policy must be underpinned by strong action against illegal migration, and that adequate funding for combating illegal migration and violations of the EU’s external borders remains essential to addressing evolving challenges; calls for EU funds to be allocated as a priority to strengthening return and repatriation measures and to securing the EU’s external borders, including by constructing and reinforcing physical barriers, in order to ensure more effective, coherent and consistent management of migration-related challenges;
